examples.text: Er hat das Papier geknüddelt und weggeworfen.
examples.translation: He rumpled the paper and threw it away.
examples.english: He rumpled the paper and threw it away.

glosses: to stuff something somewhere (e.g. clothes in a bag) thereby causing it to rumple

examples.text: Wenn du dein Hemd so in die Tasche knüddelst, brauchst du's gar nicht mitzunehmen.
examples.translation: If you stuff your shirt into the bag like this, you needn't even bother to take it with you.
examples.english: If you stuff your shirt into the bag like this, you needn't even bother to take it with you.
